class.name: SteamModerationPolicy
class.brief_description: Authorizes moderation and records audited outcomes in the trusted game backend.
class.description: Implement this policy in a trusted publisher build and inject it through [member SteamPublisherSettings.moderation_policy]. The game owns authentication, match evidence, moderator roles, review decisions, and durable audit storage. The publisher checks the exact request and target before dispatch.

method.name: _authorize
method.description: Return [code]null[/code] to deny [param request]. For a reviewed write, check moderator authorization and resolve the reviewed player for the configured app. Persist the exact action and reserve an audit reference before returning [method SteamModerationAuthorization.approve].

method.name: _record_outcome
method.description: Durably record the publisher-observed terminal [param error] and [param receipt] in the matching audit record. Return [code]true[/code] after persistence succeeds. A missing or failed write returns [constant ERR_DATABASE_CANT_WRITE] from the moderation action and preserves its receipt for reconciliation. This hook runs before the caller resumes.
